name: Zoo Corps Teen Volunteers (Hogle Zoo)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo in summer. They share what they know about animals, nature and the earth.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17. You need 2 letters of recommendation, a negative TB test and a TB screening each year. You also go to new volunteer orientation and training.
pay_detail: Unpaid. No fee is listed on the page.
duration: Summer season, June to August. At least one day a week.
deadline_text: The page says Zoo Corps applications are due April 13 with interviews April 17 and 18. It does not name the year, so this is the usual pattern.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Zoo Corps application on the zoo volunteer page. A Zoo Corps description PDF is linked there.
notes: The zoo site blocked our regular reader, so this was read through a page summary tool. Confirm the dates with the zoo volunteer office.
